doc.ep: EC.02.01.01 The hospital manages safety and security risks. EP 1. The hospital identifies safety and security risks associated with the environment of care. Note: Risks are identified from internal sources such as ongoing monitoring of the environment, results of root cause analyses, results of annual proactive risks assessments of high-risk processes, and from credible external sources such as Sentinel Event Alerts. (See also)

EC.04.01.01, EP 14)
During the survey and evaluation of conditions, the following safety issues were observed: LTC: 1. Pictures on the hallway wall were not secured. Patients ambulating may displace picture. 2. Patient in the smoke lounge was asleep and had cigarette still in mouth (not lite, but burned out) 3. e-cyliners in the gas storage room were not chained tightly and secured from potentially falling over.
? All pictures should be secured to the wall to avoid patient falls and injury. ? Patients in the smoking lounge must be monitored for lite cigarettes. ? Chain and secure all taks in storage room.
